# nginxproxymanager_version (Data Source)

The version of the running Nginx Proxy Manager.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nginxproxymanager_version" "current" {}

output "npm_version" {
  value = data.nginxproxymanager_version.current.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `major` (Number) Major version.
- `minor` (Number) Minor version.
- `revision` (Number) Revision.
- `version` (String) Full version, e.g `2.16.0`.
